title: 2024年花莲地震 · 三站实测波形
subtitle: BHZ垂直通道 · 20／40 Hz原始计数 · 1秒窗包络
description: 以同一时刻对照台北、仁川和松代三座台站的实测波形。每座台站采用自己的显示尺度。

stations.name: Taipei, Taiwan

baselineWindow.method: median of actual native counts in the 60-second pre-event window

stations.valueMeaning: Signed, actual baseline-subtracted sample of greatest absolute magnitude within the preceding second.
stations.normalization: Independent per-station display scale only; no cross-station amplitude or intensity comparison.

stations.name: Inchon, Republic of Korea

baselineWindow.method: median of actual native counts in the 60-second pre-event window

stations.valueMeaning: Signed, actual baseline-subtracted sample of greatest absolute magnitude within the preceding second.
stations.normalization: Independent per-station display scale only; no cross-station amplitude or intensity comparison.

stations.name: Matsushiro, Japan

baselineWindow.method: median of actual native counts in the 60-second pre-event window

stations.valueMeaning: Signed, actual baseline-subtracted sample of greatest absolute magnitude within the preceding second.
stations.normalization: Independent per-station display scale only; no cross-station amplitude or intensity comparison.

processing.kind: derived one-second envelopes from observed digital waveform samples
processing.baseline: median of raw counts from 2024-04-02T23:57:00Z through the following 60 seconds, exclusive end
processing.value: signed actual sample of largest absolute deviation from the pre-event median, first sample on a tie
processing.minMax: observed minimum and maximum of the same one-second window, with the same baseline removed
processing.missingPolicy: empty window null; partial window keeps actual samples and sampleCount
processing.display: per-station normalization; marker size represents relative waveform amplitude at that station

sources.name: USGS · 花莲地震震源记录
EarthScope · FDSN dataselect 原始波形
EarthScope · FDSN station 台站元数据

limitations: 数值为仪器原始计数减去震前60秒中位数。计数未经仪器响应校正，不能换算为地面运动或当地烈度。
各站灵敏度和显示尺度独立，振幅大小只在同一台站的记录内对照。
每个时刻对应刚结束的一秒窗，保留实际峰值样本、原始行号与最小—最大范围。实际样本数与原采样率不一致的窗标为不完整，空窗保留缺测。
三座台站只使用BHZ垂直通道。记录未作专业削波评估或P波、S波到时判定。
